svg.title: Native account session revocation and recovery
svg.desc: Linh signs in through the IDEA client and receives a bounded session only when the account is active. Every protected resource Module asks Identity and Accounts for current eligibility before applying RBAC and its business gates. When an Account Administrator suspends the account or recovery changes credentials, affected sessions are revoked. Later requests and resumed transfers using an old session are refused, while local Workspace files remain safe. A fresh eligible sign-in keeps the same stable Actor history.

text.tspan: [account is active and proof is valid]
